shields_note: The post names no Defensive Shields.
notes: Starting cards: the Objective; one The Signal marked '(1xSI)' (starting interrupt) and For Luck marked '(SE)' (starting effect; the strategy says 'Normal starting effect is For Luck', Rebel Fleet if there is no Sense/Alter). For Luck is the Jedi Pack card.
Posted 'R2-D2' dested R2-D2 (Artoo-Detoo); 'Artoo' is the Jabba's Palace character; 'Were doomed' We're Doomed; 'Do or do not' is the Dagobah Effect Do, Or Do Not (no Defensive Shields in 1999).
The strategy names possible swaps (Bacta Tank, Battle Plan, Planet Farthest) that he 'didn't find the space for'; not in the list.
Near-duplicate of the Trandosite page [[Bastian Winkelhaus Asteroid Sanctuary]]: same list except Trandosite has 7 X-wings and no Clash Of Sabers (DeckTech: 6 X-wings + Clash Of Sabers).
player_note: He wrote that he built it 'Going to the last tournament' (event not named) and chose not to play any mains on the Light Side.
